about: The app screenshots on the home page. tools/screenshots.py renders each scene with the screenshot harness (scripts/screens, --map-art) into public/screens/ and records the prices they show under madeWith; the tests fail when today's prices differ, so the pictures can't show an old fare.

screens.name: welcome
screens.alt: The CampusRide app's welcome screen: a green car parked at the Balme Library, under the CampusRide logo.

screens.name: home
screens.alt: The rider app's home screen: a map of campus and a Where to? search with recent places.

screens.name: plan
screens.alt: Planning a ride: pickup at the current location, and Balme Library found by typing its name.

screens.name: choose
screens.alt: Choosing a ride: the route on the map, with the Shared and Ride alone fares shown before booking.

screens.name: driver-coming
screens.alt: Driver on the way: the car on the map, the minutes until it arrives, and the driver's name, car and number plate.

screens.name: safety
screens.alt: The Safety sheet during a trip: share the trip with a contact, alert an emergency contact, or call emergency services on 112.

screens.name: driver-offer
screens.alt: The driver app showing a new ride request: the fare, what the driver earns, the pickup and the drop-off.
